dedupe_keys.name: instituto canario de estadistica istac natural hazard datasets

description: Instituto Canario de Estadística (ISTAC): natural hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Instituto Canario de Estadística (ISTAC). Coverage: Instituto Canario de Estadística (ISTAC). The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about natural hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Altitud máxima y longitud de la línea de costa. Islas de Canarias; Clasificación de intervalos temporales (ISTAC: CL_INTERVALOS_TIEMPO); Clasificación de periodos temporales respecto de los cuales se hacen c. Formats seen: SHEET, JSON, XML, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.gobiernodecanarias.org/istac/aviso_legal.html). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
